name: paysure-ai-backend
description: PaySure AI NestJS backend for NEAR intents, invoicing, and treasury guardrails

scripts.prisma:generate: mkdir -p prisma && cp ../prisma/schema.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.prisma:push: mkdir -p prisma && cp ../prisma/schema.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && prisma db push --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
scripts.postinstall: mkdir -p prisma && cp ../prisma/schema.prisma prisma/schema.prisma && prisma generate --schema=prisma/schema.prisma
